ai_offers.title: Google Gemini API — Free tier (AI Studio)
ai_offers.description: Official free tier for the Gemini Developer API: free input/output tokens with rate limits. Flash-class models (e.g. Gemini 2.5/3.x Flash, Flash-Lite) are free of charge on the Free plan; some Pro/image models are paid-only. Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products — check terms. No credit card required to start.
ai_offers.offer_value: Free tokens on Flash models · rate-limited (see AI Studio rate limits)
suitable_reasons: Best no-card developer API free tier among frontier providers
Official pricing lists Free of charge for many Flash models
AI Studio for quick experiments + API key for apps

ai_offers.title: GroqCloud — Free developer rate limits
ai_offers.description: Fast inference API with free-tier rate limits at the organization level (RPM/RPD/TPM vary by model, e.g. llama-3.1-8b-instant and gpt-oss models). View exact limits in console settings. Free plan is suitable for prototypes; upgrade to Developer for higher limits / Batch / Flex.
ai_offers.offer_value: Free RPM/TPM per model (e.g. 30 RPM class models) · check console Limits page
suitable_reasons: Very low latency free inference for demos

ai_offers.title: Cloudflare Workers AI — Free Neurons/day
ai_offers.description: Workers AI is available on the Free plan with a daily free allocation of 10,000 Neurons at no charge. Usage above that requires Workers Paid ($0.011 per 1,000 Neurons beyond free allocation). Good for edge AI demos without a separate LLM vendor bill.
ai_offers.offer_value: 10,000 Neurons/day free on Workers Free plan
suitable_reasons: Documented free daily Neurons on official pricing page
Pairs with free Workers request limits
No separate AI vendor signup if you already use CF

ai_offers.offer_value: Copilot Student + partner credits (DO $200 thru 2026-07-31 · Azure ~$100 · others)

Official GitHub Education page is source of truth
Includes AI coding assistant + cloud credits
